target_description: Clean-room Centipede-inspired arcade game, touch-first and playable on iPhone Safari; deployed via GitHub Pages at https://github.com/wdavidpence/cenitpede-clone

checklist.item: Phase 0 baseline — repo identity and architecture plan documented
checklist.notes: README.md present; docs/architecture.md and docs/project-plan.md authored

checklist.item: Phase 1 vertical slice — playable game loop with player, mushrooms, centipede, collisions, scoring
checklist.notes: Game loop fixed (rAF single chain, timing reset on restart). Three-way shooting with wing-offset spawn points (left/right bullets emanate from ship wings, not center). Space bar now works as fire key (matches HUD prompt). All core systems verified: spawn/update/render/collision/cleanup/scoring/game-state paths confirmed in full diff audit.

checklist.item: Phase 2 enemy ecology — segment behavior, head turns, spider/flea/scorpion interactions
checklist.notes: Spider distance-based scoring (300/600/900 per authentic disassembly). Flea spawns mushrooms while descending (authentic). Scorpion poisons mushrooms it crosses. Centipede starts with12 segments (authentic), head turns at mushrooms/walls with cooldown gate, tail follows predecessor. Chaser segments use wave-scaled speed. Spawn position corrected (no arbitrary wave*4 offset). NEW: centipede segments nibble mushrooms (HP-1) when crossing them, authentic to arcade.

checklist.item: Phase 3 rules and cabinet feel — scoring tuning, audio, particles, HUD
checklist.notes: Authentic scoring: mushroom=1pt, centipede head=100/body=10, flea=200, scorpion=1000. Extra life every12,000 points (max6, authentic). 6 Web Audio sound effects with wave-transition pitch variation by wave number. Particle FX system with80-particle cap. Screen-flash overlays. HUD shows score, lives, wave, high score with localStorage persistence. NEW: authentic 4-hit mushroom destruction cycle (HP=4, visual degradation per hit, 1pt on destruction). Mushroom regen after player death (one per empty row, authentic escalating difficulty). Poison scales with mushroom HP.

checklist.item: Phase 4 iPhone Safari hardening — touch-action, safe-area, orientation
checklist.notes: Architecture specifies aspect-ratio and padding strategy for safe areas; viewport-fit=cover; touch-action:none on controls. Touch slide-off detection for dpad buttons.

checklist.item: Autonomous loop infrastructure — STATE.json + supervisor.sh + docs/autonomous-loop.md

last_test_report.details: Scorecard: syntax OK, smoke PASS, all9 gameplay markers present. Syntax check: inline JS compiles without error. Full manual audit: all spawn/update/render/collision/cleanup/scoring/game-state paths verified reachable. Smoke tests updated to cover authentic scoring values, spider distance-based scoring, extra life mechanic, centipede head vs body scoring, mushroom HP decrement/destruction/size-scaling, centipede nibble, mushroom regen after death.

next_action: Phase 2 remaining: implement authentic centipede split mechanic (hitting head creates independent head that moves to top, body segments behind become separate groups). Phase 3 remaining: authentic player speed (fast in all directions within bottom zone), tighter player zone (bottom 20% only). Phase 4 remaining: orientation lock, viewport-fit behavior audit on real device.
